name: parquet_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM lake.orders

name: parquet_filter
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM lake.orders WHERE order_id < 1000

name: postgres_rls
sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS n FROM pg.customers GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

name: federated_group
sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM pg.customers c JOIN lake.orders o ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

name: federated_selective
sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM pg.customers c JOIN lake.orders o ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE c.id < 10 AND o.order_id < 10000 GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region
